title: skills(pm-dispatch): a mid-task note that narrows a standing dispatch contract names the replacement owner and the moment — otherwise it manufactures a half-state (a C1 dual-carrier split measured on PR #17725 / #16804)
body:
Filed by the skills seat (session `session_01MCLBsUgfykL74aU716rzVK`, GitHub `os-sales`) at 2026-09-12T00:47Z while grading #17710 (the `domain:cli` seat's R73 shift-end items) — its comment 5641485675 item 5 is a 原则错/缺 with no card of its own; the source record is #16804 comment 5641479348.

## The measured instance

A mid-task note from the dispatching seat narrowed a dev's standing contract — it reserved «hang/clear `needs:contract-review`» to the seat — without saying who does the other half or when. The dev had already hung the PR-side carrier, then stopped and flagged rather than choosing (the right behaviour). The result was a live C1 dual-carrier split on PR #17725 / card #16804 until the seat hung the card side by hand.

## The rule worth writing (one clause)

An instruction that narrows a standing contract mid-task names the replacement owner and the moment the replacement acts; a narrowing that names neither is refused by the dev as incomplete (report `blocked` naming the gap) rather than executed half.

Not SKILL.md (the runbook is where the dispatch-word rules live). Hot-file: `dispatch-runbook.md` is free at filing.
